sections.description: Browser-saved product collections with branded email and optional newsletter consent.
sections.changelog:
= 0.2.5 =
* Prevent text highlighting when repeatedly clicking Remove while keeping keyboard focus visible.

= 0.2.4 =
* Show installed plugin details and release notes when the release service is unavailable.

= 0.2.3 =
* Match Attentive setup to the branded Save to Email connection controls.
* Choose email logos from the WordPress Media Library with replace/remove controls.

= 0.2.2 =
* Keep separators between shop items and remove the final item’s border above the email footer.

= 0.2.1 =
* Show one introduction when sharing a post: sender attribution when named, otherwise the generic introduction.

= 0.2.0 =
* Add private usage analytics with bounded daily totals for favorites, collections and post emails.
* Organize settings into MTT-styled tabs with native controls and draft email previews.

= 0.1.26 =
* Bring all collection and post emails closer to CLJ’s website with serif typography, warm paper, fine frames and square buttons.
* Make Saved for Later the prominent heading above the post title.

= 0.1.25 =
* Include the bordered featured image when sharing a post by email.

= 0.1.24 =
* Place Saved for Later above the post title in personal saved-post emails.

= 0.1.23 =
* Include the featured image in personal saved-post emails with a padded border and a Read the post button.

= 0.1.22 =
* Separate post sharing by email from saving a post for later with a bookmark icon.

= 0.1.20 =
* Match the post email popup heading, introduction and button to the save prompt.

= 0.1.19 =
* Give post and wishlist opt-in checkboxes separate editable wording.
* Restore the post email button wording.

= 0.1.18 =
* Give the post email popup its own introduction and send button wording.

= 0.1.17 =
* Remove the decorative mail icon from email dialogs.

= 0.1.16 =
* Restore the email icon and let themes share their native artwork across mail controls and dialogs.

= 0.1.15 =
* Remove the decorative divider from email dialogs.

= 0.1.14 =
* Open email forms at their complete size while preparing the collection.
* Preserve unfinished form entries and prevent sending before preparation completes.

= 0.1.13 =
* Replace the decorative envelope in email dialogs with a simple brand-colored divider.

= 0.1.12 =
* Remove the collection count summary from email forms.

= 0.1.11 =
* Show only the number of finds in collection email form summaries.

= 0.1.10 =
* Let the collection header scroll on phones while keeping the close button reachable.

= 0.1.9 =
* Keep the intro, collection count and email/share actions visible with the modal heading.

= 0.1.8 =
* Keep the collection heading and close button visible while saved finds scroll.

= 0.1.7 =
* Display encoded punctuation and ampersands correctly in collection titles, brands and emails.

= 0.1.6 =
* Show collection progress and the next batch size; reveal older finds without replacing loaded cards.

= 0.1.5 =
* Add an editable email newsletter checkbox default; sharing always excludes newsletter signup.

= 0.1.4 =
* Shorten collection and email copy to match CLJ’s voice.

= 0.1.3 =
* Show newest saved finds first across collection views and emails.

= 0.1.2 =
* Add optional sender name, reply-to email and a personal message when sharing a collection.

= 0.1.1 =
* Smooth first collection opening with reserved card space and softly revealed images; keep loaded cards when reopening.

= 0.1.0 =
* Add guest product collections, accessible hearts and shared modal/page views.
* Add branded list/post email, optional Attentive consent and expiring large-list sharing.

* Refine CLJ collection pages, mobile dialogs and email forms; keep newsletter signup unchecked.
* Add floating-heart placement controls, animated dialog opening and click-outside dismissal.
